rule_title: TTP T1546.008 - cmd.exe spawned by winlogon.exe with sethc.exe argument
description: Detects the sticky keys backdoor being triggered. winlogon.exe spawns cmd.exe with sethc.exe in the command line arguments — this happens when a user presses Shift 5 times at the login screen after the IFEO debugger or binary replacement backdoor has been planted. The process runs in the winlogon session context (SYSTEM).
